summary_1line: Sumali sends Kaikasi to marry sage Vishravas, leading to the births of Ravana, Kumbhakarna, Shurpanakha, and virtuous Vibhishana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kaikasi stands shyly before the fire‑lit sage Vishravas during his sacrifice, eyes lowered as she scratches the earth with her toe.
The monstrous infant Dashagriva is born with ten necks and twenty arms as jackals howl and blood rain falls under a darkened sun.
Young Dashagriva vows before his mother to surpass the radiant Kubera after watching him ride the flying chariot Pushpaka.
